params.body:
The widget picks its language from the dealer's setting or from `?lang=`, and the filter labels followed. Seven strings did not, because they were typed straight into the blade.

A French dealer reported it through Ilse on 23 September 2026, with a screenshot in which MARQUE, MODÈLE, TYPE DE TRANSMISSION and TYPE DE CARBURANT sit next to **Meer filters**, above **0 wagens** and **Geen wagens gevonden met deze filters.**

| what | where |
| --- | --- |
| "Filters" / "Meer filters" | `search.blade.php` |
| the result count, "wagen" / "wagens" | `vehicles.blade.php` |
| "laden…" on the infinite-scroll sentinel | `vehicles.blade.php` |
| "Geen wagens gevonden met deze filters." | `vehicles.blade.php` |
| "Uitgebreide waarborg" and its sentence | `detail.blade.php` |
| the page title "Tweedehandswagens" | `index.blade.php` |

All of them now live in `resources/lang/{nl,fr,en,de}/website.php`. The count goes through `trans_choice`, because singular and plural differ per language and zero has to read as a plural ("0 wagens", "0 véhicules", not "0 wagen").

## The test is the other half

`TheWidgetSpeaksTheVisitorsLanguageTest` reads every blade of the widget, strips the comments, the expressions and the directives, and fails on any remaining visible text node that carries a word only Dutch has. Four pairs of eyes do not catch this reliably; this does, and it immediately found two places the screenshot did not show.

`gone.blade.php` stays outside that scan, with the reason in the method: it is the 410 answer of R S2-5.26 and leaves the middleware before `WebsiteController` picks a language, so `?lang=` is never read on that path. Translating it would change nothing a visitor sees; moving the language choice into the middleware would, and that one neutral sentence does not justify it.

## Verified

`TheWidgetSpeaksTheVisitorsLanguageTest` plus the neighbouring widget tests (`WebsiteThemeTest`, `WebsiteOwnVehiclesFirstTest`, `WebsiteModalPositionTest`, `TheEmbedFollowsThePackageTest`, `WebsiteEmbedSettingsTest`, `ChipsSelectTest`): 32 tests, 269 assertions. The rule-catalogue tests (`RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesSourcesTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`): 20 tests green.

The full local suite could not be run before proposing: a safety hook in the session started failing closed on the command. CI runs all 2049 tests here.
params.title: The widget speaks the visitor's language, everywhere
